Name: (DMOC) Increase Food Price
Author: DMOC4215
Description:
This mod increase the food price so cooking is profitable. All recipe will not deficit even with iridium quality material. [color=#ffff00]
[/color]Most food price are iridium quality material x 120%. not include skill bouns.[color=#ffff00]
﻿
[/color][color=#ff7700][b]Tip:[/b][/color][color=#ffff00]
﻿Food that existed before adding MOD still use old price, newly cooked food will use new price.[/color][color=#ffff00]
[/color] ﻿"The Stardrop Saloon" sell food with double price. Like "Salad" now need 720g[color=#ffff00]
﻿
[/color][color=#ff7700][b]What happened:
[/b][/color][list]
[*]Now use iridium quality material price as cost. Cheese and Mayonnaise using gold quality.
[/list] ﻿[color=#ff7700]example:[/color] "Cheese Cauli." [color=#ff7700]([/color] "Cauliflower"([color=#ff00ff]350g[/color]) + "Cheese"([color=#ffff00]345g[/color]) [color=#ff7700]) x 120%[/color] = 834, rounding to 830.
﻿
[list]
[*]These things use vanilla price: "wheat flour"(50g), "suger"(50g), "oil"(100g), "vinegar"(100g), "Rice"(100g)
[/list] [color=#ff7700]example:[/color] "Pink Cake": [color=#ff7700]([/color] "Melon"([color=#ff00ff]500g[/color]) + "Egg"([color=#ff00ff]190g[/color]) + "Wheat flour"(50g) + "suger"(50g) [color=#ff7700]) x 120%[/color] = 948, rounding to 950.
﻿
[list]
[*]Recipe that can use any fish count as 200g
[/list] ﻿[color=#ff7700]example:[/color] "Maki Rool": [color=#ff7700]([/color] [color=#00ff00]Any Fish(200g)[/color] + "Seaweed"(20g) + "Rice"(100g) ) [color=#ff7700]x 120%[/color] = 384, rounding to 985.
﻿
[list]
[*]If recipe has food inside, it will not count again
[/list] [color=#ff7700]example:[/color] "Complete Breakfast": "Milk"([color=#ff00ff]380g[/color]) [color=#ff7700]x 120%[/color] [color=#999999]+ "Fried Egg" + "Hashbrowns" + "Pancakes[/color]" =  1284, rounding to 1280.
﻿
[list]
[*]"Algae Soup" and "Pale Broth" are not change, because is more expensive with vanilla price
[/list][list]
[*]"Triple Shot Espresso" is not change.﻿
[/list][list]
[*]﻿I didn't include the skill bonus. If you chose Rancher then use Crops to cook will earn more﻿﻿. Choose tiller will let Animal products earn more. If you choose Angler, smoke fish will be better. So there is a funy balance inside.
[/list]
[b][color=#ff7700]Suggest to play with: [/color]
﻿[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19309]Market Town[/url] [color=#ffff00]Create your own Floral Shop, Restaurant, Fish Market, and more.[/color]
﻿Actually I make this mod because I want to set up a restaurant and make a fortune.
